title: The LC-QTOF-MS/MS analysis of acid degradation products of Rifaximin, an antibiotic
author: Yaseen, Akram, et al.

steps.title: Collect and store Rifaximin
steps.instruction: Obtain approximately 1 g of Rifaximin from Hilton Pharma Pvt Ltd, transfer immediately to the laboratory and store the sample in a refrigerator.

steps.title: Weigh and dissolve sample
steps.instruction: Weigh about 200 mg of the stored Rifaximin and dissolve it in 200 mL of methanol.

steps.title: Add HCl and set up reflux
steps.instruction: Add 200 mL of 0.1 M HCl to the methanol solution, transfer the mixture to a round‑bottom flask using a parallel synthesizer, and attach a condenser fitted with a chiller and a heating mantle.

steps.title: Reflux mixture
steps.instruction: Reflux the solution at 60 °C for 4–8 hours.

steps.title: Cool and transfer
steps.instruction: Allow the refluxed mixture to cool to room temperature, then transfer it to a separatory funnel.

steps.title: Extract with dichloromethane
steps.instruction: Add 50 mL of dichloromethane, shake until the phases separate, collect the lower (organic) layer; repeat the extraction two additional times (total three extractions) and combine the organic layers.

steps.title: Evaporate solvent
steps.instruction: Transfer the combined organic extracts to a round‑bottom flask and evaporate to dryness on a rotary evaporator; collect the dry solid product.

steps.title: Store crude product
steps.instruction: Store the resulting solid crude at –80 °C.
